title: Textual Entailment is not a Better Bias Metric than Token Probability

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating bias by comparing token probability (TP) metrics against a novel Natural Language Inference (NLI) task using the WinoQueer dataset. The NLI methodology measures textual entailment, contradiction, and neutral probabilities for premise-hypothesis sentence pairs involving stereotypical and counter-stereotypical statements about LGBTQ+ versus cisgender/heterosexual identities.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
